name: Mark the Target deals 1 damage to target unit
notes: Mark the Target's element is FIRE, matching the starting champion, so no lineage patch is needed. Without the full 1-reserve cost is paid with a single hand card. The starting champion is SPIRIT class, so the [Class Bonus] preparation counter does not trigger, keeping the fixture to the base always-available damage effect. A Dungeon Guide seeded onto the opponent's field is the legal target.
